Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DIMENSIONS OF SPINDLES AND MOUNTING 

ARRANGEMENTS FOR SPINDLE OPERATED 

ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS 

PART 1 SPINDLES 

Section 7 Concentric Spindle 

( Second Revision ) 



0. General — This standard ( Part 1/Sec 7 ) shall be read in conjunction with IS : 4586 ( Part 1/Sec 1 )- 
1987 'Dimensions of spindles and mounting arrangements for spindle operated electronic components: 
Part 1 Spindles, Section 1 General and definitions {second revision )'. 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions of concentric spindles. 

2. Dimensions — See Tables 1 and 1 A. 



Adopted 30 November 1987

Note 1 — If intermediate values are required, they should preferably be chosen from the R20 series (mm) 
[see IS : 1076-1967 Preferred numbers (first revision) ]. 

Note 2 — Subject to a minimum of 1 mm for dimension L\. 

Note 3 — Chamfer at. 40/50° or a radius for a depth of between 5 and TO percent of dimensions Ax and A%, 

Mote 4 — Subject to a minimum of 1 mm for dimension L t . 

Note 5 — Fixing of bush may be done by pressing a 'C washer in the groove cut in the shaft to a depth of 

1 to V5 mm. 

Note 6 — Dimension apply to spindles after suitable finish.
